description: This file defines the Organization entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping its properties to a corresponding database table using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties related to organization details such as name, contact info, address, and notes, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Entity class representing an organization's general information, mapped to the 'ohrm_organization_gen_info' database table with various address and contact properties.

methods.name: getTaxId
methods.description: Returns the organization's tax identification number.

methods.name: setTaxId
methods.description: Sets the organization's tax identification number.

methods.name: getStreet1
methods.description: Returns the first line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: setStreet1
methods.description: Sets the first line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: getStreet2
methods.description: Returns the second line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: setStreet2
methods.description: Sets the second line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the organization.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the organization.
